issue_context.title: br/stream: Support truncate unnecessary files via CLI
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

This requires a new subcommand of `br stream` -- `truncate --until <ts-string>`. Which:

- Remove all log files contains only data before <ts-string>.
- Update the metafiles involved.
